acceptanceCriteria: The owner decides whether Corvint issue work opens draft or ready pull requests, and AGENTS.md states that rule without conflicting with the machine setting.
If ready pull requests are the rule, the standing publication approval text names any added limit on auto-merge.
body: Observed 2026-10-01 in a Claude Code desktop session opening beamfall/corvint#440 and #441. AGENTS.md (Standing publication approval) says to push verified task branches and open or update draft pull requests. A PreToolUse hook on this machine refused the pull request creation command carrying the draft flag with: 'Draft PRs are disabled by user setting. Re-run ... without the draft flag (opens a ready PR)'. The hook matches the flag text anywhere in a shell command, so it also refused an unrelated command whose ticket text quoted it. Both PRs were therefore opened ready, and auto-merge was enabled per the owner's saved preference. The project contract and the machine setting disagree, so each agent has to pick one and report the deviation. Open question for the owner: should AGENTS.md say ready pull requests (or draft where the host allows), or should the setting be changed for this repository? The hook belongs to the host application, not Corvint; only the AGENTS.md wording is in this repository's control.

completion.reason: Owner decided on 2026-10-04: Corvint issue work opens ready (non-draft) pull requests, matching the machine PreToolUse hook that refuses draft creation, and arms GitHub auto-merge with the merge-commit method (decision 0319, approved in beamfall/corvint#310); merging by hand, force-pushing, deleting remote branches and releases still need explicit approval. AGENTS.md Standing publication approval states this rule and landed on main in beamfall/corvint#520 (merge commit 431d6b150b14197ed595712b8f7086cf8bf3503c). Evidence digest = sha256 of AGENTS.md at that merge commit. Both acceptance criteria are met: the owner decided, and the text names the auto-merge limit. The host hook itself is outside this repository and unchanged.

title: AGENTS.md requires draft pull requests but the owner's Claude Code hook refuses the draft flag
